Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aarav - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Anjali - 42 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Vimla - 74 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
4. Kavya - 11 years, friend
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
5. Vihaan - 12 years, friend
Look: red T-shirt, jeans

Places

1. The fishermen's village - boats, nets, coconut palms

Scene 1: The fishermen's village - Day

[Aarav stands in the village. Anjali, Vimla and Kavya stand near him.]

Vimla: "Let's do something fun today."

[Waves crash against the shore.]

Kavya: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
